instruction_2: Turn left and walk straight down the long hallway towards the windows. Once you pass the bar area, turn right and enter the living room. Stop in front of the doors leading outside.
instruction_3: Turn left. Wait in between the table and chairs on the right and the couches.

instruction_1: Go forward toward the mirrors. Exit the bedroom area through the door directly ahead. Enter the hallway, and turn left. Go toward the indoor dining table. Stop there.
instruction_2: Walk around the front of the bed past the arm chair in the corner. Walk out through the door in the corner of the room past the mirrored closet doors. Walk into the tiled hallway. Turn the corner in the hall and walk to the next corner with a painting on the wall and a vent on the wall around the corner. Walk into the next room with a dining table and cabinets against the wall.
instruction_3: Walk towards the mirror, and take a right. Walk straight through the open door in front of you. Make a hard left, then another. Wait by the long table.

instruction_1: Walk straight through the kitchen. Turn slightly right to continue walking straight down the hallway. Turn right and wait near the entrance of the second room on the left.
instruction_2: Walk through the kitchen, turn slight right, wait near the bedroom doorway.
instruction_3: Turn left and walk straight across the kitchen and through the storage area. Once out, turn right and then enter the last room on the left and stop in the doorway.

instruction_1: Walk past the kitchen and wait in the short hallway at the far end of the kitchen.
instruction_2: Go between the couch and the island straight down the hallway. Pass through the next room and then turn right. Stop in front of the bathroom door and wait there.
instruction_3: Turn left and walk past the kitchen and then through the living room. Turn right at the eye chart and stand next to the bathroom door.

instruction_1: Exit the bedroom. Walk the opposite way of the picture hanging on the wall through the kitchen. Turn right at the long white countertop. Stop when you get past the two chairs.
instruction_2: Turn left and exit the bedroom. Turn left and go in to the kitchen. Turn right and wait next to the counter.
instruction_3: Exit room and wait between the couch and kitchen island.

instruction_1: Go do the hall, and go left. Take the right before you enter the entry way, and go straight. Stop once you are on the rug, behind the desk chair.
instruction_2: Walk down the hall to the left of the clock and turn right. Walk past the picture and stop in front of the chair.
instruction_3: Leave the sitting room and go left. Take a right before you enter the foyer. Go straight into the office. Stop on the rug in front of the bookcase.
